grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: A Family Cooking Conversation
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音会播放两遍。每题只有一个正确答案。填空题的答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有场景与数据均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: Mia: Dad, can you cook chicken? Dad: Yes, I can. I can cook chicken and rice. Mia: Great! Can Uncle Tom cook? Dad: No, he cannot. He can only make tea. Mia: Oh! Does Mom like fish? Dad: Yes, she does. She likes fish, but she doesn't like tomatoes. Mia: I like carrots, but I don't like tomatoes. Dad: Me too! Does your brother like carrots? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes potatoes. Dad: OK. We have chicken, rice, and carrots for dinner. Mia: Perfect!

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 当主语是he、she、it或一个人名时，动词一般要加-s或-es，例如likes、cooks。问“他/她/它……吗？”用Does开头，回答用Yes, he/she does.或No, he/she doesn't.。问“能/会……吗？”用Can开头，回答用Yes, he/she can.或No, he/she cannot.。like表示“喜欢”，can表示“能/会”。and表示“和”，but表示“但是”。
grammar.example: She likes fish, but she doesn't like tomatoes.

questions.explanation: 主语He是第三人称单数，动词like要加-s，变成likes。
主语she是第三人称单数，问句用Does开头，后面的动词用原形like。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的回答：Can Uncle Tom cook?
questions.explanation: Can开头的问句用can或cannot回答，不用doesn't。

options: I like carrots, but I don't like tomatoes.
I like carrots, and I don't like tomatoes.
I like carrots, but I not like tomatoes.
answers: I like carrots, but I don't like tomatoes.
questions.explanation: 前后意思相反时用but连接；否定用don't like。
questions.evidence: I like carrots, but I don't like tomatoes.
